tiktok.caption: Nobody warned you about the RMD Tax Bomb hiding in your 401k. Maxing it could trigger $400K in taxes you never planned for.

youtube_short.title: Your 401k Has a Hidden $400K Tax Bomb
title_alternatives: The RMD Trap Nobody Warns You About
youtube_short.description:
If you've been maxing your 401k your whole career — congrats, but the IRS built a forced withdrawal rule called an RMD that kicks in at 73 and could cost you $400K in taxes you never planned for. Add Medicare IRMAA surcharges up to $7,128/year and 85% of Social Security becoming taxable, and you've got three financial hits from one account. The fix? A Roth conversion between ages 60-72 — search 'Roth conversion ladder' to learn more. #retirement #401k #personalfinance #taxes #RMD #wealthbuilding

Follow for more money truths nobody in the office will tell you.
